左右移动不改变序列奇偶性，上下移动相当于移动(n-1)位，如果n为偶数影响奇偶性.zh: 左右移动不改变序列奇偶性，上下移动相当于移动(n-1)位，如果n为偶数影响奇偶性，n为奇数则不影响。 因此转化为求整条序列的逆序对。这里采用树状数组。 先把所有数离散化为1-n(这道题不需要)，然后从后往前遍历。对当前元素x，答案加上tree[x-1]（即在此之前遇到过的小于x的数），然后在tree的x对应位置+1，表示已经遇到过了。
左右移动不改变序列奇偶性，上下移动相当于移动(n-1)位，如果n为偶数影响奇偶性.en: Left and right movements do not change the parity of the sequence, while up and down movements are equivalent to moving (n-1) steps. If n is even, it affects the parity; if n is odd, it does not. Therefore, it is converted into finding the inversion pairs of the entire sequence. Here a Fenwick tree (Binary Indexed Tree) is used. First, discretize all numbers into 1-n (not needed for this problem), then traverse from back to front. For the current element x, add tree[x-1] to the answer (i.e., the numbers smaller than x encountered before), then increment tree[x] by 1 to indicate x has been encountered.

求全排列序列的奇偶性，即求把它还原成1-n正序的交换次数。全排列可以唯一分解为多.zh: 求全排列序列的奇偶性，即求把它还原成1-n正序的交换次数。全排列可以唯一分解为多个循环。一个有 n 个数的循环可以通过 n-1 次元素交换变回递增的序列。
求全排列序列的奇偶性，即求把它还原成1-n正序的交换次数。全排列可以唯一分解为多.en: Determine the parity of a permutation sequence, that is, calculate the number of swaps needed to restore it to the 1-n ascending order. A permutation can be uniquely decomposed into several cycles. A cycle with n numbers can be restored to an ascending sequence with n-1 element swaps.

拖了三天的题目。 树上dp.dp数组记录每个点向下一趟之后回到原来的点的代价。d.zh: 拖了三天的题目。 树上dp.dp数组记录每个点向下一趟之后回到原来的点的代价。dp[root]=(dp[l]+1)+(dp[r]+1)+1=dp[l]+dp[r]+3.这里使用后序遍历可以完成更新。 然后使用前序遍历记录每个点的答案。res[i]=dp[i]+res[parent]. 由于递归爆栈需要使用stack手动模拟。后序遍历使用双栈。stack按根左右压入，每次把根压入新栈，这样新栈是根右左的顺序。然后倒着遍历栈，就是左右根的顺序。
拖了三天的题目。 树上dp.dp数组记录每个点向下一趟之后回到原来的点的代价。d.en: A problem that dragged on for three days. Tree DP. The dp array records the cost for each point to go down once and return to the original point. dp[root] = (dp[l]+1)+(dp[r]+1)+1 = dp[l]+dp[r]+3. This can be updated using post-order traversal. Then use pre-order traversal to record the answer for each point. res[i] = dp[i] + res[parent]. Because recursion may cause stack overflow, a stack has to be used for manual simulation. Post-order traversal uses a double stack. Push the stack in root-left-right order into a new stack each time with the root, so the new stack is in root-right-left order. Then traverse the stack in reverse, which results in left-right-root order.

首位放到最后和01变化的顺序不影响。因此先01变化，对长度为偶数的数列来说就够了.zh: 首位放到最后和01变化的顺序不影响。因此先01变化，对长度为偶数的数列来说就够了。对奇数来说，考虑是否需要首位移动。首位移动到最后，相当于把字符串和自己拼一起，并以长度为n的窗口滑动。每次移动时减去前一位对cnt的贡献，加上新的一位对cnt的贡献。实时更新每个窗口的ans，取最小值。
首位放到最后和01变化的顺序不影响。因此先01变化，对长度为偶数的数列来说就够了.en: Placing the first bit last and the order of 01 changes do not matter. Therefore, changing 01 first is sufficient for sequences of even length. For odd numbers, consider whether to move the first bit. Moving the first bit to the end is like concatenating the string with yourself and sliding through the window of length n. Each time you move, subtract the contribution of the previous bit to CNT and add the contribution of a new bit to CNT. Update the ANS of each window in real time, taking the minimum value.

KMP.next[i]表示前i个数的最大公共前后缀的长度，也是在这一个位置失配时.zh: KMP.next[i]表示前i个数的最大公共前后缀的长度，也是在这一个位置失配时模式串的指针应该跳到的位置。 构建next数组，目标串（模式串）指针在i=0，模式串指针在j=-1.同样可以使用KMP的移动规则，每次两个指针前移一位并记录next[i]，如果失配j就往回跳，一位都不对跳到-1自然从头开始。 找循环节，最小循环节长度=L-next[L]。
KMP.next[i]表示前i个数的最大公共前后缀的长度，也是在这一个位置失配时.en: KMP.next[i] represents the length of the longest common prefix and suffix of the first i numbers, and it is also the position where the pattern pointer should jump to when there is a mismatch at this position. Construct the next array with the target string (pattern string) pointer at i=0 and the pattern pointer at j=-1. The KMP movement rule can also be used here: move both pointers forward one step each time and record next[i]; if there is a mismatch, j jumps back. If nothing matches, jump to -1 and start over naturally. To find the repeating cycle, the minimum cycle length = L - next[L].

一个集合记录包含所有需要数的杂志，一个集合记录所有包含不需要数的杂志，最后两集合.zh: 一个集合记录包含所有需要数的杂志，一个集合记录所有包含不需要数的杂志，最后两集合作差集即可。 不能一边读一边进行集合运算，否则前一步不需要的杂志后一步可能又加回来。 a(需要）集合初始化为第一个符合的集合，注意要set()复制一份而不要直接取引用，否则会把原数据修改。
一个集合记录包含所有需要数的杂志，一个集合记录所有包含不需要数的杂志，最后两集合.en: Use one set to record all magazines containing the needed numbers, and another set for all magazines containing unwanted numbers; finally, take the difference between the two sets. You cannot perform set operations while reading, otherwise a magazine not needed in a previous step might be added again later. Initialize the a (needed) set with the first matching set, and make sure to copy it with set(), not use a reference directly, otherwise the original data will be modified.

随机选取中心点c，向外划分64个环，每个环取m个点，并将每个点的权重定为card.en: Randomly select a center point c, divide outward into 64 rings, take m points in each ring, and set the weight of each point as card(ring[i])/m. Then calculate the distances from all selected points to q. Note that the long long range is 2^64, about 1e18, so when calculating distance, first convert the difference in each dimension coordinate to double.

Shunting Yard调度场算法。建立答案栈和符号栈，根据运算规则存入弹出符.en: Shunting Yard scheduling algorithm. Create an answer stack and an operator stack, push and pop operators according to operation rules.

要求查找和插入都O(1)，使用哈希表。要求灵活将内容移到队尾与删除队首，使用双向.zh: 要求查找和插入都O(1)，使用哈希表。要求灵活将内容移到队尾与删除队首，使用双向链表。 也可以使用Python内置的ordered_dict完成，有move_to_end()和popitem(last=False)模块。
要求查找和插入都O(1)，使用哈希表。要求灵活将内容移到队尾与删除队首，使用双向.en: To achieve O(1) for both search and insertion, use a hash table. For flexibly moving elements to the end of the queue and deleting the front, use a doubly linked list. Alternatively, Python's built-in OrderedDict can be used, which has move_to_end() and popitem(last=False) methods.

滑动窗口+单调队列。把所有点按x坐标排序，易知右侧点的left必定比左侧点的le.zh: 滑动窗口+单调队列。把所有点按x坐标排序，易知右侧点的left必定比左侧点的left大。因此可以使用滑动窗口，同时使用两个单调队列分别维护段中的最大值与最小值，每次的新值加入队尾并保持递增/递减，最值从队头取，老值从队头删除。
滑动窗口+单调队列。把所有点按x坐标排序，易知右侧点的left必定比左侧点的le.en: Sliding window + monotonic queue. Sort all points by x-coordinate; it is easy to know that the left of points on the right will always be greater than the left of points on the left. Therefore, a sliding window can be used while using two monotonic queues to maintain the maximum and minimum values within the segment. Each new value is added to the tail of the queue while keeping it increasing/decreasing, the extremes are taken from the head of the queue, and old values are removed from the head.

二分答案。删点可以一路贪心往前，如果距离比当前距离近就右边向右，否则左边右边同时.zh: 二分答案。删点可以一路贪心往前，如果距离比当前距离近就右边向右，否则左边右边同时向右。
二分答案。删点可以一路贪心往前，如果距离比当前距离近就右边向右，否则左边右边同时.en: Binary search on the answer. When deleting points, you can greedily move forward; if the distance is closer than the current distance, move the right boundary to the right; otherwise, move both the left and right boundaries to the right.

顺序同中序转后序表达式，然后使用计算波兰表达式的方法。.zh: 顺序同中序转后序表达式，然后使用计算波兰表达式的方法。
顺序同中序转后序表达式，然后使用计算波兰表达式的方法。.en: Convert the expression from infix to postfix in order, then use the method to calculate a Polish expression.

遍历每一行，并加入总和中。如果总和是数组和的一半，或者减去某个遍历过的数之后符合.zh: 遍历每一行，并加入总和中。如果总和是数组和的一半，或者减去某个遍历过的数之后符合要求，则正确。删除上半部分的数可以由哈希表维护，把0加入表示不删除。删除下半部分即把数组倒过来。竖着分割即把数组转置。 转置的方法是先*grid解包，再zip. 注意特判只有一列的情况，此时只能删第一个或者分割线上的。第一行在处理完第一行后才能删，最后一行同理。
遍历每一行，并加入总和中。如果总和是数组和的一半，或者减去某个遍历过的数之后符合.en: Traverse each row and add to the total sum. If the total sum is half of the array sum, or after subtracting any traversed number it meets the requirement, then it's correct. Deleting numbers in the upper half can be maintained using a hash table, adding 0 means no deletion. Deleting the lower half means reversing the array. Vertical splitting means transposing the array. The transposition method is first *grid unpack, then zip. Note special case when there is only one column, in which case only the first element or the one on the split line can be deleted. The first row can only be deleted after processing it, and the last row similarly.

二进制存储每行、列与九宫格的状态。 mask & (-mask)：取出最低位的1.zh: 二进制存储每行、列与九宫格的状态。 mask & (-mask)：取出最低位的1，从最低位开始尝试。 digit = bin(digitMask).count(“0”) - 1：获得最低位的1是第几位。 mask &= (mask - 1)：去掉最低位的1 启发式搜索：先把能唯一确定的格子填好，再对不确定的格子dfs. 注意dfs的时候如果成功了要传递状态并return掉，避免把好的结果覆盖掉。
二进制存储每行、列与九宫格的状态。 mask & (-mask)：取出最低位的1.en: Use binary to store the state of each row, column, and 3x3 grid. mask & (-mask): extract the lowest bit set to 1, try from the lowest bit. digit = bin(digitMask).count("0") - 1: find which bit the lowest 1 is. mask &= (mask - 1): remove the lowest 1. Heuristic search: first fill cells that can be uniquely determined, then DFS on uncertain cells. Note: during DFS, if successful, pass the state and return to avoid overwriting a correct result.
